_source: HCM 7th Edition, Chapter 30, Example Problem 1, eastbound direction — COMPUTED MODE. Identical to case1.json except the Chapter 30, Section 4 access-point delay procedure (access_point_approaches, Equations 30-31 through 30-68) computes the per-access-point through delay in place of the case1 published-input hook (access_point_delays_s). The two active access points seen by the eastbound through movement are AP1 (adjusted volumes 74.80 L / 981.71 T / 93.50 R veh/h, opposing westbound 991.70 T + 94.45 R) and AP2 (75.56 L / 991.70 T / 94.45 R, opposing 981.71 T + 93.50 R), both undivided two-through-lane approaches with no turn bays (Exhibit 30-35). The integration test asserts the computed per-access-point delays reproduce the published 0.193 (AP1) and 0.194 (AP2) s/veh and the published inside-lane blockage probability 0.115, and that every downstream performance measure reproduces the published Exhibit 30-36 values identically to case1. The right-turn branch uses the posted speed limit (35 mi/h); see the access_point_delay VERIFY-HCM note.
